newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs eye 134.84 on any rate cut bounce.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs eye 134.84 on any rate cut bounce.

text.p: September futures on LIFFE will aim for the all-time high of 134.84 on Monday, taking strength from the Bank of Italy's (BOI) interest rate cut on Friday, technical analysts said.
"We'll see an extension of Friday's late gains first but then maybe a bit of disappointment," Louise Jones, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London said.

The BOI cut the discount rate to 6.25 percent from 6.75 percent and the Lombard rate 50 basis points to 7.75 percent after LIFFE closed on Friday. In APT trade BTPs rallied 47 basis points but failed to recapture the old high.
Jones said a 38.2 percent retracement of the rally from the 129.07 low on June 10 to the high at 134.84 would give a downside ojective of 132.62.
Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London said a breakthrough of the 134.86 wave area was on the cards, with potential to the 135.09 wave target.
"Daily stochastics remain in overbought territory but have yet to see a bearish crossover, keeping the bias on gains," they said in a research note.
BTPs were quoted at 134.62 at 0702 GMT, up 54 basis points.
September Eurolire were up 10 basis points at 93.54.
